```{r setup, include=FALSE}
emit_table <- function(data, caption, align = NULL, col_names = names(data)) {
  cat(knitr::kable(
    data,
    format = "html",
    caption = caption,
    escape = FALSE,
    align = align,
    col.names = col_names,
    table.attr = "class='replication-table'"
  ))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r table-1}
emit_table(
  table_1,
  "Table 1. Descriptive statistics of the core variables"
)
```

```{r table-2}
emit_table(
  table_2,
  "Table 2. Donor countries used to construct the synthetic counterfactual European Union"
)
```
